title: fix(app-shell): the report builder saves a package-shipped report into the app's .custom overlay
body:
Fixes #36716

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在报表编辑器里修改应用包自带的报表并保存时，修改现在写进该应用的定制包，不再报 403 丢失修改；没有包归属的报表照旧保存，用户无其他变化。
- 属于「Studio 定制都进 .custom」这条主线，替日常调整已安装应用报表的管理员解决保存失败的问题，与仪表盘页内编辑的保存路径保持一致。
- 若判断错了，管理员在打开编辑器时就会看到说明原因的提示（无权定制或包列表缺版本），而不是保存时才失败；改动只在界面一侧，直接撤回本次合并即可恢复原状。
- 无

## What changes

- `ReportView` (the report builder and the report inspector panel) now resolves where a Save lands when the editor opens, with the same resolver the in-page dashboard editor uses: the package the report is served from when it is writable, else the app's customization package `<base>.custom` (ADR-0146 D2, D3, D11). The ensure door is asked for the pair at Save, the body declares `overrides: { package, basedOn }` as Studio's Customize writes it, and the save plus publish target that package.
- Where such a save could not land, the editor does not open and a toast says why, in Studio's own sentences: the owner package is not listed, the ensure door is walled for this caller, or the package list names no installed version to declare the override at.
- A report that names no package is saved exactly as before (no package named on the save or the publish).
- `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` gets item-neutral names for the dashboard editor's target helpers (`resolveInPlaceEditTarget`, `ensureInPlaceSaveTarget`, `inPlaceSaveBody`, `saveInPlace` and their types). The dashboard names stay as aliases that delegate, so the dashboard callers are untouched. The module is internal to `@object-ui/app-shell` (not in its `exports`).

Read first, by risk:

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.tsx`, the `handleOpenBuilder` hunk: the three refusal branches decide when the editor does not open.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.tsx`, the `saveSchema` hunk: the body and target of the write.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.shippedReportSave-36716.test.tsx`: the new pin.

## Why

On `origin/main` the report editor saved every edit naming no package, so the save of a report a read-only installed package ships addressed that package and the metadata write door answered 403; the admin's change was lost at Save. ADR-0146 D11 and the ruling cited at `designModeMenuCreate.ts` decide that such an edit goes into the app's `.custom` overlay. The card's alternative (say the report is read-only up front) conflicts with that ruling and is not taken, as the claim records.

## Tests

<details><summary>New pin: ReportView.shippedReportSave-36716 (4 cases)</summary>

The real `ReportView`, `ReportBuilderHost`, persistence seam and target resolver over a metadata client double and the two package doors:

- a report a read-only package ships: the buffer is read at the served package, `ensureCustomizationPackage('showcase')` is asked at Save, the save goes to `packageId: 'showcase.custom'` with `overrides: { package: 'showcase', basedOn: '3.2.0' }`, and the publish names `showcase.custom`;
- a writable owner (control): saved and published in that package, no pair asked, no `overrides`;
- no package: saved and published naming none, the package list never read;
- the three refusals: the editor does not open, the toast names the reason, nothing is saved, no pair is asked.

Two existing ReportView pins (`authoredEditBuffer-35008`, `headingStaysServed-36373`) now answer the package list and expect the save and publish to name the writable package the report is served from.

</details>

<details><summary>Runs (head fad5ea01bf8, after merging origin/main 8e4ac50d430)</summary>

- `vitest run` on the three ReportView pins: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 12 passed (12); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: passed (both the src program and `tsconfig.test.json`).
- Every app-shell test file that names `ReportView`, `runtime-metadata-persistence`, `DashboardInPageEditor`, the dashboard target helpers, `designModeMenuCreate` or `publicForms` (41 files): Test Files 41 passed (41), Tests 345 passed (345); lock VERDICT command-exit 0. Narrowed, declared: the whole app-shell suite (2,426 test files) was started and stopped after about 70 minutes holding the shared lock; `Test UI` runs it in CI.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (fix committed first; mutation landed on disk, then restored)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the save target `target` with `{ kind: 'unbound' }` in `saveSchema` (the old behaviour: the save names no package). Anchor 1 to 0, blob `14ec5897d718` to `73b2daaae6fc`. Predicted before the run: the shipped case and the writable control go red, the unbound and refusal cases stay green. Observed: 2 failed, 2 passed (the shipped case on the save options, the control on `{ mode: 'draft', ifNoneMatch: '*' }` lacking `packageId`). Restore: blob equals HEAD `14ec5897d718`, `git diff HEAD` empty. No build step: the test imports `./ReportView` from source.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The browser check on the showcase report (`showcase_hours_by_status_chart`) is reported on the card in the dev report, not here: it needs the whole workspace built for `pnpm dev`, which was still queued on the shared lock when this PR opened.
- The non-customization save still writes the builder's buffer as it is (no stripping of top-level underscore keys), as before this change; only a customization body goes through `overrideDraftBody`.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.shippedReportSave-36716.test.tsx` and expect 4 passed. In the app: `OS_PORT=3000 pnpm dev`, open Reports, then "Hours by Status (Chart)", Edit, change the chart type, Save. Expect a success toast and the change still there after a reload, with the save request going to `?package=` the app's `.custom` package.

Local gates: the full `dispatch-gates --commands` derivation for this diff, 38 families: 37 exit 0, `check:type-check-debt` NOT MEASURED (first run hit a 500 s timeout, the second never got the shared verify lock: exit 3). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 38 accounted, 37 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (derived from the recorded exit 3).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint over the five changed files: 0 errors; the repo-wide run is CI's.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [ ] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not applicable: `packages/spec` is not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
